claims.claim: Invoices from foreign suppliers (AWS, Google, OpenAI, Figma, Upwork, most overseas SaaS) carry NO Israeli VAT; the 18/118 rule must not be applied to them. Import VAT on goods is reclaimed only via the customs import entry (רשימון יבוא). Foreign-currency amounts convert to ILS at the invoice-date rate.
claims.raw_snippet: Invoices from foreign suppliers (AWS, Google, OpenAI, Figma, Upwork, most overseas SaaS) carry NO Israeli VAT; the 18/118 rule must not be applied to them. Import VAT on goods is reclaimed only via the customs import entry (רשימון יבוא). Foreign-currency amounts convert to ILS at the invoice-date rate. VAT Law 5736-1975 §7 (import) and §30; import VAT evidenced by רשימון יבוא.

claims.claim: Input VAT on business hospitality/entertainment (אירוח) is NOT deductible under תקנה 16 of the VAT Regulations 1976 (except hosting a guest from abroad). Employee-benefit inputs (meals/gifts) fall under תקנה 15א. Light in-house refreshments (כיבוד קל) are 80% deductible for income tax.

claims.claim: Regulation 14(a) of the VAT Regulations 1976 forbids a dealer from deducting input VAT on the purchase or import of a 'private vehicle', even where the vehicle is used solely for business transactions (100% business use), except for the exceptions listed in Regulation 14(b).
claims.raw_snippet: תקנה 14(א) לתקנות מס ערך מוסף, התשל"ו - 1976 שתוקנה מכוח סעיף 44(1) לחוק, אוסרת על עוסק לנכות את מס התשומות עבור רכישה או יבוא של "רכב פרטי", גם אם הרכב משמש או נועד לשמש את העוסקים אך ורק לצורכי העסקאות לשימוש בעסק למעט החריגים המנויים בתקנה 14(ב) לתקנות.

claims.claim: The 2/3 input-VAT deduction rate comes from Regulation 18 on mixed use: where the Director has not fixed the relative share and the asset or service is used mainly for business, the dealer may deduct two thirds of the input VAT (and only a quarter where the main use is non-business).

claims.claim: Regulation 18 sets the input-VAT split on mixed-use vehicle running costs. If the Director has fixed the non-business proportion, that stands. If not, a dealer whose MAIN use is for business may deduct two thirds; a dealer whose main use is NOT for business may deduct only a quarter.
